description: A Benchmark Model for Power System Restoration Studies is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tadej Škrjanc, Leopold Herman (University of Ljubljana, Faculty of Electrical Engineering). This repository contains the Benchmark Restoration Model (BRM) and its associated parameter data developed for the analysis of power system restoration dynamics following large-scale blackouts. The model represents a simplified, yet realistic electrical power system designed to reproduce key restoration-related phenomena, including network energization, black start coordination, load pick-up, synchronization, and interactions involving inverter-based resources. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
